intro: Razorflank's Medallion is a personal token carried by Charlga Razorflank, the crone ruling over Razorfen Kraul. Recovered from the heart of the quillboar stronghold, it serves as undeniable proof that the matriarch has been brought down.

p: Carried by Charlga Razorflank herself, this medallion represents the authority of the crone who leads the Razorfen quillboar. When Falfindel Waywarder at Thalanaar learns of the fates of fallen explorers like Heralath and the dwarf Lonebrow, he tasks Alliance adventurers with striking directly at the quillboar leader. Presenting the crone's medallion confirms her death, reassuring the night elf sentinels guarding the borders of Feralas that the gathered forces within the Kraul have lost their leader.
